script.base: Dome, modest road favorite, not a blowout. NE -3.5 with a 46.5 total points to a competitive game NE leads or stays within a score, implied 25-21.5. Pace is normal with no weather drag. NE mixes: Maye keeps the run (Henderson 24/84 and Stevenson 20/70 over weeks 3-5, Gibson's 19/76 now off the field) and still throws to Diggs (22 targets, 270 yards, 205 air) and Henry (17/175/150). NO as a 3.5 home dog keeps Kamara (41/139, ankle questionable) and Miller (28/133) involved early but has to throw to Olave (31 targets, only 136 yards) and Shaheed (16/203/200). Late, if NE is ahead, the lead backs carry the clock; skill players should finish because 3.5 is not a blowout flag.
script.flip1: NE jumps up by two scores. NO abandons the run, so Kamara and Miller rush yards die and Rattler/Olave/Shaheed attempts spike. NE runs the clock; Diggs and Henry routes stall after halftime the way a favorite's passing stats stall in a 38-21 type script.
script.flip2: NO hangs around or leads. Both passing games stay live in the dome, Shaheed/Olave and Diggs/Henry all remain in play, and NE's rush share fades if Maye is chasing, which is the flip that kills a Henderson rush over. Kamara keeps carries only if the ankle allows a full load.

matchup.pressure: NO blitzes 35%. NE EPA/db is 0.48 vs the blitz and 0.17 vs no blitz, so this blitz has been the better look for Maye, not a suppressor. No pressure rate, time-to-throw or sack split is saved, so do not assume the blitz gets home or forces checkdowns. NE blitzes only 22%. NO EPA/db is 0.21 when blitzed and -0.09 when not, so the base looks NE will mostly show are the ones that have stalled NO.
matchup.bleeds: NO run defense allows 4.41 YPC with 17 runs of 10+ in 5 games; the pass bleed is the middle (8.9 YPA), while the left side is stingy (6.05 on 63). Only 11 passes of 20+ (161) in 5 games, so NO is not an explosive-pass sieve. NE run defense is the other way: 3.65 YPC and 10 runs of 10+. NE pass defense bleeds explosives (21 passes of 20+, 166) plus the middle (9.06) and left (8.12).
matchup.overlap: Core overlap is Diggs, the NE primary (22 targets, 205 air yards over weeks 3-5), into NO's middle leak (8.9 YPA) and a 35% blitz NE has posted 0.48 EPA/db against, with Yiadom out. Henry (17 targets, 150 air) lives in the same middle but his 46.5 line sits on weeks 4-5 (39 and 46), so he is not a selected leg. Henderson's carries overlap the soft NO run front (4.41 YPC, Ridgeway out), not a coverage matchup. Shaheed's 200 air yards overlap NE's explosive leak and Hawkins being out, but that is a noted non-leg because the line is on his pre-spike cluster.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and this lost. Diggs stayed under 57.5 because the 101 and 146 were one-play weeks we could not chart, NO took the primary away, and NE leaned on a soft run front (4.41 YPC, Ridgeway out, Gibson's carries consolidated) so Maye never needed a 7-target Diggs day; the 23- and 32-yard games are already on the sheet. Henderson stayed under 27.5 because Stevenson and Maye took Gibson's 19 carries, the 3.5-point game flipped into a chase, and 8 carries at his own 3.5 YPC is 28 yards with no margin, which the 10-yard game already proved. The counter-case is stronger on Henderson (0.5-yard L3 cushion, unknown carry split) than on Diggs (22 targets and 205 air yards are not a one-play stat line), which is why Henderson is a lean and Diggs is flagged rather than cut. Kamara's ankle and Johnson's LB boost were considered and left off so they do not sneak back onto the slip.
slip_story: Do not parlay these two as a must-hit stack. Diggs over belongs to the NE-beats-the-blitz / middle-of-field story and dies if NE salts a lead. Henderson rush over belongs to the favorite-runs-the-clock story against the soft NO front, which is the flip that stalls Diggs. They coexist only in the base competitive script (NE -3.5, total 46.5, both units finish). No TD legs, one market per player, Diggs is WR1 not a depth receiver. No 3-4 leg slip: Henry 46.5, Boutte 28.5, Shaheed 47.5 and Miller 27.5 were the correlated candidates and none cleared both the read and the kill-case. Prices absent, so this is a pre-kick read log, not a wager.
